Daily Devotional

September 22

17 And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name. (Luke 10:17 KJV)

This is where Jesus sent out 70 of His disciples to announce His coming and to heal the sick and cast out demons. They came back full of joy, as they saw all the demons cast out of the ones who were possessed by them. Not only can we, as disciples of the Lord, cast out demons, but also we can heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, etc., as that is what Jesus told us to do (John 14:12). The churches that are teaching that those things are no longer available to us are not being truthful, as it is just as important for us to do all those things today, as it was in the days of Jesus. God did not intend for the church to be so powerless as it is today and I am sure that Jesus is not happy with our lack of demonstrating God’s power.

Notice that the devils are subject through the name of Jesus. A Christian can still cast out demons, but not in your own name, and you have to use the name of Jesus and have faith in His name, to be able to do the works that Jesus did, and told us to do. If all Christians could just understand the awesome power that God has given us, this world would have many less demons, and sickness and disease would be taken care of by us, instead of all the doctors. Thank you Jesus for all you have given to us. Now let’s go use this power!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
